author: Kanak Suman
message: I loved how you presented the other side of Pride that many of us hadn't thought of. We grew up leaning to earn respect, for that we were forced in scoring good in institutions that led towards bookish knowledge, being a topper gives you a temporary tempting pride so you start focusing more on books that kills your creativity, your thinking ability. Then you struggle to get a job that will give you a good respect, again you loses your interest. If only we overcome the fear of pride, we can achieve satisfaction. We can love what we have then crying upon what we missed.
